hook_angle: audience callout (first-time retinol users) with reassurance
visual_layout: upright tube centred on soft grey with a cream dollop below and three callout lines to percentage-result stats
proof_device: disclosed study stat footnoted 'Based on Dermatological Assessment'
color_palette: soft grey, white, navy, burgundy; calm, clinical, premium
risk_notes: relies on result percentages (-50% pores, +100% smoother, -88% fine lines) footnoted only to a generic 'Dermatological Assessment' with no study size or source; 'without purging or irritation' is an absolute tolerance claim
why_it_works: Names a hesitant audience and removes their main fear (irritation) in the subhead, then backs it with three big numbers placed around the pack so the eye moves product to proof. Calm grey styling makes an active ingredient feel safe.
